description.value: Critical Success the target notices the attempt and can't be targeted by Entry Made again today. Success unaffected. Failure you learn one true fact the target is actively trying to hide — not its deepest secret, just whatever's most relevant right now. Critical Failure as failure, and the target has no idea anything was read from it. Either way on a failure, the Ledger writes the fact down whether you wanted it to or not; it's now on record.

cinderfall.listing: Bargain Spells / The Ledger debts · secrets · everything written down
